propositions: ADF encoding is hardwired into Cloud path while Data Center uses plain text/wiki markup, requiring a shared codec contract to eliminate duplication between two deployment-specific implementations

The RichTextCodec Protocol must expose four separate operations (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) to preserve the distinct composition orders used by existing Cloud callers without silent behavior change

AdfCodec must live in adapters/jira/rich_text_codec.py to satisfy the import contract that forbids jira_family from importing location-pinned Cloud modules; WikiTextCodec lives in the shared jira_family/rich_text.py

The shared map_fields_to_remote implementation must relocate to adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py as a single decorator-injectable function taking RichTextCodec as a constructor dependency, with Cloud backend delegating to it
WikiTextCodec must truncate at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) with a marker identical to adf._ADF_TRUNCATION_SUFFIX, counted against the limit so fitted output never exceeds capacity

No new ADF references outside the codec layer are permitted; ADF calls must originate only from adf.py definitions, AdfCodec, location-pinned outbound_fields.py, or the explicitly out-of-scope inbound path
